input: # Element sequences, PGN spec 8.2. Parsed with the `movetext` start rule,
# so each row is one line of play with no tag section around it.
# A move number indication with no move after it is legal and empty.
# --- an element sequence needs no numbers at all ---
# --- 8.2.4 numeric annotation glyphs attach to the move they follow ---
# A glyph before any move annotates the starting position, not a move.
# --- whitespace is not significant between elements ---
# --- 6 the escape mechanism: a % in the first column only ---
